entries.title: The job died and I do not know why
symptoms: The job died. Where do I look first?

tail -30 vasp.out    (standard output / scheduler log)
tail -5  OSZICAR     (electronic or ionic phase?)
tail -40 OUTCAR      (last thing VASP did)
entries.plain: The run stopped and you do not know why. VASP writes its errors to the screen log, not to OUTCAR, so start there.
causes: VASP prints errors to standard output, not to OUTCAR. OSZICAR tells you whether the run stopped during an electronic loop or between ionic steps.

fixes.text: Read the error text in standard output and search this handbook for its keyword.
No message at all: usually wall-time limit or out of memory. Check the scheduler log.
Before restarting, check CONTCAR and WAVECAR are not empty.

entries.title: Error reading WAVECAR, or a stop right after start-up
messages: the number of k-points / bands changed, WAVECAR mismatch
symptoms: "Error reading WAVECAR" or the run stops right after start-up
ls -l WAVECAR     → 0 bytes
ERROR: the number of k-points / bands changed, WAVECAR mismatch
entries.plain: VASP tried to reuse the saved wavefunctions from an earlier run, but the file is broken or does not match this run.
causes: The previous job was killed while writing WAVECAR, or it comes from a different build, k-mesh or spin setting.
Reading WAVECAR from a different setup
Reading WAVECAR from a different setup (workflow handbook).

fixes.text: Delete the WAVECAR, or set ISTART = 0.
Restart from CONTCAR (copied to POSCAR) if the geometry is worth keeping.
ISTART = 0 or delete WAVECAR

entries.title: The distance between some ions is very small
messages: The distance between some ions is very small
symptoms: "The distance between some ions is very small"
Warning in standard output / OUTCAR
The distance between some ions is very small
entries.plain: Two atoms sit almost on top of each other, which nearly always means the structure file was read wrongly.
causes: Coordinates in the wrong mode (Cartesian read as Direct or vice versa), a wrong scaling factor, or duplicated atoms.
Overlapping atoms; wrong scale or coordinate type
Duplicate sites from a CIF (workflow handbook).

fixes.text: Open POSCAR in VESTA and look at it.
Check the Direct/Cartesian line and line 2 (scale).
Check the atom counts on line 7 match the coordinates.
Check POSCAR line 2, Direct vs Cartesian, duplicate sites from CIF

entries.title: IBZKPT: k-lattice belongs to a different class of lattices
messages: VERY BAD NEWS! internal error in subroutine IBZKPT
Reciprocal lattice and k-lattice belong to different class of lattices
symptoms: "VERY BAD NEWS! internal error in subroutine IBZKPT: Reciprocal lattice and k-lattice belong to different class of lattices"
Appears during setup
entries.plain: The k-point mesh does not have the same symmetry as the crystal, so VASP cannot reduce it.
causes: The k-mesh does not share the lattice's symmetry: typically a shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh on a hexagonal or fcc cell, or unequal subdivisions on equivalent axes.

fixes.text: Switch to a Γ-centred mesh.
Use the same subdivision along symmetry-equivalent directions.
Last resort: ISYM = 0.

entries.title: Tetrahedron method fails (fewer than 4 k-points)
symptoms: "Tetrahedron method fails for NKPT<4"
Error at start-up
Tetrahedron method fails (number of k-points < 4)
entries.plain: The tetrahedron method needs at least four distinct k-points and your run has fewer.
causes: ISMEAR = −5 needs at least 4 irreducible k-points; large supercells or Γ-only runs have fewer.
ISMEAR = −5 set somewhere (e.g. copied INCAR)
ISMEAR = -5 set somewhere, for example copied from another INCAR (workflow handbook).

fixes.text: Use ISMEAR = 0 with SIGMA = 0.05.
Or increase the k-mesh if the cell is small.
ISMEAR = 0, SIGMA = 0.05 as in this workflow

entries.title: A relaxation ran as molecular dynamics
symptoms: I asked for a relaxation but OSZICAR shows temperatures (T=) and the atoms fly around
OSZICAR lines like:  1 T= 312. E= ... EK= ...
entries.plain: You asked for several ionic steps without choosing a relaxation method, so VASP ran molecular dynamics.
causes: NSW > 1 was set without IBRION, so IBRION defaulted to 0 (molecular dynamics).

fixes.text: Set IBRION = 2 (or 1) explicitly in every relaxation INCAR.

entries.title: Found a more primitive cell
messages: PRICEL: found a more primitive cell
symptoms: "Found a more primitive cell" / Bravais-lattice warnings
Warning in standard output / OUTCAR
PRICEL: found a more primitive cell
entries.plain: VASP found that your cell is a repeat of a smaller one. That is fine for a supercell you built on purpose.
causes: Your supercell has a smaller primitive cell, or the lattice symmetry VASP detects differs from the one you set.
Cell is a supercell of a smaller one

fixes.text: Usually harmless for intended supercells.
If unexpected, compare the space group in OUTCAR with the one you meant to build.
Use the primitive cell, or ignore deliberately (supercell intended)
ISYM = 0 if it breaks things

entries.title: The electronic loop does not converge
symptoms: Electronic loop does not converge (NELM reached, dE oscillates or stalls)
OSZICAR: 60 DAV/RMM lines per ionic step, dE jumping by ±1E-2
entries.plain: The electronic loop keeps going without settling, which is usually a sign that the structure or the mixing needs attention.
causes: Charge sloshing in metals, slabs or large cells; a poor starting guess; a magnetic state flipping between solutions; too few empty bands; an unsuitable algorithm.

fixes.text: Check the structure first: overlapping atoms or a broken geometry cause most "unconvergeable" cases.
ALGO = All (or Damped), and raise NELM to 150–200.
Reduce mixing: AMIX = 0.1, BMIX = 0.0001 (linear mixing for slabs and charge sloshing); for magnets also AMIX_MAG = 0.4, BMIX_MAG = 0.0001.
Slightly larger smearing for metals (SIGMA 0.1–0.2) during the hard phase.
Increase NBANDS by ~20% when the highest bands are occupied.
Start from a converged WAVECAR of a simpler setting (e.g. PBE before HSE, or non-magnetic before magnetic).

entries.title: Sub-Space-Matrix is not hermitian, or EDDDAV ZHEGV failed
messages: Sub-Space-Matrix is not hermitian in DAV
Error EDDDAV: Call to ZHEGV failed
symptoms: "Sub-Space-Matrix is not hermitian in DAV" or "Error EDDDAV: Call to ZHEGV failed"
Error in standard output during the Davidson step
Sub-Space-Matrix is not hermitian in DAV
EDDDAV: Call to ZHEGV failed
entries.plain: The numerical solver for the electron states broke down, often because of a bad structure or a clumsy starting point.
causes: Numerical breakdown of the Davidson diagonalization, often from a bad geometry, an unstable start, or aggressive settings.
Davidson instability (ALGO = Fast/Normal)
Ill-conditioned subspace, often bad geometry or random start
Ill-conditioned subspace, often bad geometry or random start (workflow handbook).

fixes.text: Check the geometry for very short distances.
Change ALGO to All, or back to Normal if it was Fast (the Workflow Handbook lists Fast as a cause of this error and avoids it for magnetic or +U systems).
Restart without WAVECAR (ISTART = 0).
Try a different NCORE or fewer ranks to rule out parallel issues.
ALGO = All or Normal
Change core count/NCORE
Check geometry
ALGO = All / Damped
Delete WAVECAR
Check interatomic distances
Change parallelization
ALGO = All or Damped, delete WAVECAR, check interatomic distances (workflow handbook).

entries.title: BRMIX: very serious problems
messages: BRMIX: very serious problems the old and the new charge density differ
symptoms: "BRMIX: very serious problems the old and the new charge density differ"
Warning in standard output
BRMIX: very serious problems
entries.plain: The charge density that was read in does not belong to the structure now being calculated.
causes: The density read or mixed is inconsistent with the current setup, often after restarting with a changed structure, cell or symmetry.
Mixer confused, e.g. CHGCAR/WAVECAR from a different structure
CHGCAR or WAVECAR from a different structure (workflow handbook).

fixes.text: Restart without CHGCAR/WAVECAR (ICHARG = 2, ISTART = 0).
Set ISYM = 0 if symmetry changes between steps.
Reduce AMIX/BMIX if it recurs during normal SCF.
Remove old CHGCAR/WAVECAR
Restart
Adjust AMIX/BMIX

entries.title: Large entropy term (T*S) in OUTCAR
symptoms: Large "entropy T*S" in OUTCAR
grep "EENTRO" OUTCAR | tail -1
entries.plain: The smearing is so wide that the smeared energy no longer matches the energy at zero smearing.
causes: SIGMA is too large for the system, so the smeared energy is far from the zero-smearing energy.

fixes.text: Reduce SIGMA until |T·S| / atoms < 1 meV/atom.
For insulators use ISMEAR = 0 with SIGMA = 0.05, or ISMEAR = −5 for static runs.

entries.title: The relaxation does not finish in NSW steps
symptoms: Relaxation does not finish in NSW steps, or forces oscillate just above EDIFFG
OSZICAR energies go up and down; OUTCAR never prints "reached required accuracy"
entries.plain: The relaxation keeps stepping without reaching your force target.
causes: Noisy forces from loose electronic convergence, a step size too large near the minimum, or a very flat energy surface.

fixes.text: Copy CONTCAR to POSCAR and continue.
Tighten EDIFF (1E-6 or 1E-7) and set NELMIN = 4–6.
Reduce POTIM to ~0.1.
Switch IBRION = 2 → 1 for the final steps (or 3 for poor starts).
Use PREC = Accurate and LREAL = .FALSE. for small cells; test ADDGRID.

entries.title: ZBRENT: fatal error in bracketing
symptoms: "ZBRENT: fatal error in bracketing"
Error in standard output during an IBRION = 2 relaxation
ZBRENT: fatal error in bracketing
entries.plain: The relaxation algorithm could not find the bottom of the energy valley along its search direction.
causes: The conjugate-gradient line search could not bracket a minimum, usually because forces are noisy or the structure is already near the minimum.
Line minimization in CG failed; poor forces or step
Line minimization in CG failed; poor forces or step (workflow handbook).

fixes.text: Copy CONTCAR to POSCAR and restart.
Tighten EDIFF.
Switch to IBRION = 1, or reduce POTIM.
If forces are already below your target, the structure may simply be converged.
Cp CONTCAR POSCAR and restart
Lower POTIM
Tighten EDIFF
IBRION = 1 near minimum

entries.title: The lattice keeps changing when ISIF = 3 is rerun (Pulay stress)
symptoms: Lattice keeps changing when I rerun ISIF = 3, or static energy disagrees with the relaxation
OUTCAR "external pressure" and "Pulay stress"; volume differs between successive runs
entries.plain: The basis set was fixed for the starting cell, so a cell that changes size feels a false pressure.
causes: Pulay stress. The plane-wave basis is set up for the starting cell; as the volume changes, the effective cutoff changes and the stress is biased.

fixes.text: Use ENCUT ≈ 1.3 × max ENMAX for cell relaxations.
Rerun from CONTCAR until the volume no longer changes (normally 2–3 rounds).
Finish with a static run at the final structure.

entries.title: The vacuum layer of a slab disappeared
symptoms: My slab's vacuum layer disappeared
c lattice vector shrinks in CONTCAR
entries.plain: The cell was allowed to change shape, and with nothing resisting, the empty layer was squeezed away.
causes: ISIF = 3 relaxes the cell; the vacuum has no stress to resist compression.

fixes.text: Use ISIF = 2 for slabs, surfaces and molecules in a box.

entries.title: The magnetic moment collapses to zero
symptoms: The magnetic moment collapses to zero
OSZICAR "mag=" tends to 0.000
Moment collapses to 0
entries.plain: The magnetic moment fell to zero, either because spin was not switched on or because the starting guess was too small.
causes: ISPIN = 1 by mistake, an initial moment too small to reach the magnetic minimum, or a genuinely non-magnetic ground state.
Starting MAGMOM too small, or NM state really lower
Starting MAGMOM too small, or the non-magnetic state really is lower (workflow handbook).

fixes.text: Check ISPIN = 2.
Set MAGMOM somewhat above the expected value.
Compare energies of magnetic and non-magnetic solutions to see which is lower.
Start at 3–5 μB
Compare energies
Check ISPIN = 2 is set
Start at 3–5 μB and compare energies (workflow handbook).

entries.title: An antiferromagnetic start ends ferromagnetic
symptoms: An antiferromagnetic start ends ferromagnetic, or moments are forced equal
OUTCAR "magnetization (x)" shows equal signs on all sites
entries.plain: An antiferromagnetic start turned ferromagnetic, usually because the starting pattern was written in the wrong atom order.
causes: MAGMOM does not encode the AFM pattern in POSCAR order, or the cell is too small to hold the AFM order.

fixes.text: Check the MAGMOM order against POSCAR.
Use a supercell that accommodates the ordering.
ISYM = 0 if you need symmetry breaking beyond the starting pattern.

entries.title: Bands or DOS look shifted
symptoms: Bands or DOS seem shifted; the gap appears in the wrong place
Different E-fermi values in SCF and NSCF OUTCARs
entries.plain: The zero of energy is in a different place in two runs, so the plots do not line up.
causes: The Fermi level of an ICHARG = 11 run is less reliable than the SCF value; for insulators E_F can sit anywhere in the gap.

fixes.text: Shift by the E-fermi of the SCF run.
For semiconductors and insulators align E = 0 to the VBM.

entries.title: The band structure looks wrong or noisy
symptoms: The band structure looks wrong or noisy
Jagged bands, unexpected gap
entries.plain: The band plot looks jagged or has the wrong gap, usually because the density was not read from the right SCF run.
causes: ICHARG = 11 missing (density re-converged on the path), a CHGCAR from a different structure or ENCUT, or too few bands.

fixes.text: Copy CHGCAR from the SCF of the same structure; set ICHARG = 11.
Raise NBANDS to see the conduction bands.
Hybrids: use IBZKPT + zero-weight path points instead.

entries.title: Bader charges change with settings
symptoms: Bader charges change with settings or don't make sense
Sum of charges ≠ number of electrons; values change with grid size
entries.plain: Bader charges depend on the density grid and on including the core density, so they move with your settings.
causes: CHGCAR alone lacks the core density, and a coarse FFT grid makes integration inaccurate.

fixes.text: Set LAECHG = .TRUE.; use AECCAR0 + AECCAR2 as the reference.
Increase the fine grid (NGXF, NGYF, NGZF) until charges converge.

entries.title: pymatgen or ASE cannot read vasprun.xml
symptoms: pymatgen / ASE fails to read vasprun.xml
XML parse error
entries.plain: The analysis tool cannot read vasprun.xml because the job stopped before the file was closed.
causes: The job did not finish, so the XML was never closed.

fixes.text: Check "Elapsed time" in OUTCAR; rerun if the job did not finish.
Some parsers can read truncated files; otherwise use OUTCAR/OSZICAR.

entries.title: The run is slow or runs out of memory
symptoms: The run is far slower than expected, or runs out of memory
OUTCAR "LOOP:" times per electronic step; scheduler memory errors
entries.plain: The run is slow or runs out of memory, which is often a parallel layout that does not suit the system.
causes: Unsuitable parallel layout, reciprocal-space projection in a large cell, or too many k-point groups for the memory.

fixes.text: Large cells (> ~20 atoms): LREAL = Auto.
Many k-points: raise KPAR (watch memory).
Few k-points, large cell: tune NCORE (try 4, 8, 16).
Out of memory: lower KPAR, use more nodes, or use vasp_gam for Γ-only runs.
Set LWAVE and LCHARG to .FALSE. when the files are not needed.

entries.title: EDDRMM: call to ZHEGV failed
symptoms: EDDRMM: call to ZHEGV failed
entries.plain: The faster electron solver failed. A slower one is more robust.
causes: RMM-DIIS failed

fixes.text: ALGO = Normal instead of Fast/VeryFast

entries.title: LAPACK: Routine ZPOTRF failed
symptoms: LAPACK: Routine ZPOTRF failed
entries.plain: A matrix inside the solver was not valid, which points at a damaged structure or a damaged WAVECAR.
causes: Overlap matrix not positive definite; distorted structure or corrupt WAVECAR

fixes.text: Delete WAVECAR
Lower POTIM
ALGO = Normal
Check POSCAR

entries.title: SGRCON: symmetry detection error
messages: VERY BAD NEWS! internal error in subroutine SGRCON
symptoms: VERY BAD NEWS! internal error in subroutine SGRCON
entries.plain: VASP found symmetry that does not agree with the coordinates you gave it.
causes: Symmetry detection inconsistent with coordinates

fixes.text: Symmetrize POSCAR
Change SYMPREC (1E-4 → 1E-3)
ISYM = 0

entries.title: Inverse of rotation matrix was not found
messages: inverse of rotation matrix was not found
symptoms: inverse of rotation matrix was not found (increase SYMPREC)
entries.plain: Atoms sit slightly off the positions the symmetry needs, so VASP cannot close the symmetry group.
causes: Positions slightly off symmetric sites

fixes.text: SYMPREC = 1E-4 or larger
Symmetrize structure

entries.title: Too few bands (NBANDS too small)
symptoms: TOO FEW BANDS / NBANDS too small
entries.plain: The calculation has too few empty bands, so the top band is still partly filled.
causes: Partially filled top band

fixes.text: Increase NBANDS by 20–30%

entries.title: Error reading item MAGMOM
symptoms: Error reading item 'MAGMOM'
entries.plain: The number of MAGMOM values does not equal the number of atoms.
causes: Count does not match NIONS

fixes.text: One value per atom (3 per atom for ncl)

entries.title: REAL_OPTLAY: internal error
symptoms: REAL_OPTLAY: internal error / RSPHER
entries.plain: The real-space projection step failed. Switching it off is the standard remedy.
causes: Real-space projection problem

fixes.text: LREAL = .FALSE.

entries.title: CNORMN: search vector ill defined
messages: WARNING: CNORMN: search vector ill defined
symptoms: WARNING: CNORMN: search vector ill defined
entries.plain: The relaxation step was too large, or the electrons were not converged well enough.
causes: Ionic step too large or poor SCF

fixes.text: Lower POTIM
Tighten EDIFF
Switch IBRION

entries.title: LEPSILON or IBRION = 7, 8 with NCORE or NPAR
symptoms: LEPSILON / IBRION=7,8 not supported with NCORE/NPAR
entries.plain: Perturbation-theory runs cannot use band parallelization, so NCORE and NPAR must be removed.
causes: Band parallelization in DFPT

fixes.text: Remove NCORE and NPAR

entries.title: Imaginary phonon modes
symptoms: Imaginary phonon modes
entries.plain: Phonon modes with imaginary frequency can mean a loose calculation or a real structural instability.
causes: Loose relax/EDIFF, small supercell, or genuine instability

fixes.text: EDIFF 1E-8, EDIFFG −0.001, ADDGRID, larger DIM
Follow eigenvector if persistent

entries.title: Negative or odd elastic constants
symptoms: Negative or odd elastic constants
entries.plain: Elastic constants came out negative or odd, which usually points to leftover stress or too coarse settings.
causes: Residual stress, low ENCUT, coarse k-mesh, wrong Voigt mapping

fixes.text: Re-relax at elastic ENCUT
Denser k
EDIFF 1E-8
Use VASPkit 203 conversion
